_comment: TEMPLATE — fill every TODO from your HALO / HALO Link deployment. Indica Labs does not publish a tile URL scheme:
programmatic access is the HALO GraphQL API (HALO 3.0+), documented in the Indica Labs customer portal.
If your HALO Link exposes image tiles at plain URLs (check with your HALO admin), describe them here.
Otherwise use the connector wissi already has: python scripts/wissi_probe.py yourpkg.halo:make_connection --images ...

info.path: TODO: metadata path for one image, e.g. /…/images/{image}
info.width: TODO: field with the full-resolution width
info.height: TODO: field with the full-resolution height
info.tile_size: TODO: field with the tile size (or put a number in a fixed 'pyramid' block instead)
info.mpp: TODO: field with microns per pixel (optional)
info.version: TODO: a field that changes when the image changes (modified date / etag)
info.levels: TODO: field with the list of pyramid levels (or use 'downsamples')
info.level_id: TODO: field passed back as {level} in tile URLs
